test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Three cubes of equal volume are joined end to end. Find the surface area of the resulting cuboid if the diagonal of the cube is 6√3 cm.
solution:
**Given:**

Diagonal of cube = 6√3 cm

**Calculations:**

Diagonal of cube = √3 × side 

⇒ 6√3 = side √3

Hence, side = 6

So, length of cuboid = 3 × 6 = 18 

Breadth = 6 and height= 6

So, the surface area of the cuboid

= 2(lb + bh + lh)

= 2(108 + 36 + 108)

= 2 × 252 cm²

= 504 cm²

**Hence, The Required value is 504 cm².**
